title: Cue configuration
description: Configuration for cue, the GitHub-issue agent pipeline runner. Lives at .cue/config.json in the target repo. Every field is optional.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor autocompletion.

repo.description: GitHub repository as owner/name. Auto-detected from the origin remote when unset.

adapter.description: Which headless agent CLI drives the stages. "agy" is an alias for "antigravity". Model names are adapter-specific, so setting "models" requires setting this explicitly too.

models.description: Per-stage model, passed straight to the selected CLI. Defaults to the adapter's own set. Requires "adapter" to be set explicitly.

triage.description: Model for plan generation and replan.

dev.description: Model for implementation and review fixes.

maxTurns.description: Per-stage turn cap. Enforced by the claude adapter only (--max-turns); codex and antigravity have no turn cap.

reviewFixIterations.description: How many times the review verdict may send the dev agent back for fixes before the stage gives up. 0 disables the fix loop.

gate.description: Deterministic gate run in the worktree after dev. Executed through the OS shell (sh -c, cmd /c on Windows) — keep commands shell-portable.

test.description: Test command. A non-zero exit fails the dev stage.

lint.description: Optional lint command, run after the tests pass.

devBashAllowlist.description: Shell command patterns the dev and fix agents may run (Claude permission syntax). Unset means Bash is unrestricted. Enforced by the claude adapter only — codex and antigravity get a full shell inside their sandbox.

worktreeRoot.description: Where per-issue git worktrees are created. Defaults to ~/.cue/worktrees/<owner>-<repo> — deliberately outside the target repo so IDE indexing never sees it.

baseBranch.description: Branch that draft PRs target, and the branch worktrees are cut from. Cue never merges and never commits to it.

staleClaimMinutes.description: How long an agent:in-dev claim is treated as live before another poll may pick the issue up again.
